address: Gran Vía 9, Donostia / San Sebastián, 20002, Spain
bio: A casual restaurant occupying a stone basement with a modern feel (striking photos, neon lighting, background music etc) run by a Brazilian chef with a passion for fusion cooking, hence dishes with influences from France, Japan, Mexico etc. Discover the chef’s full creativity via an interesting 7-course tasting menu (887's Signature). An array of half-plate options is also available....
